app.title: ECHO TOWER
app.subtitle: MASTER'S HAND
settings.title: Settings
settings.reset.confirm: Reset all progress? This cannot be undone.
settings.export.hint: Copy the code to move your progress to another device.
buildings.altar.desc: Summoning altar. Altar level lowers the summon cost.
buildings.barracks.desc: A vault of engravings and gear. Storage level increases hero XP.
buildings.dining.desc: A long table and steam over food. Hall level strengthens meals.
buildings.training.desc: Rift, Arena, Trials and other modes. Level adds a ★ trial attempt.
buildings.archive.desc: Codex shelves and the memory of the fallen. Archive level adds floor crystals.
storage.title: Storage
storage.empty: Empty for now. Engravings and gear appear after battles and rewards.
quests.title: Quests
tower.title: Tower
tower.recommendLow: Your power is below the recommendation — upgrade the squad or change element.
tower.repeatNote: Repeat: only 10% gold, no other rewards
tower.hint.fight: Pick a floor — the battle starts immediately
tower.hint.sweep: Pick a cleared floor — collect the reward without a battle
tower.hint.info: Pick a floor — open its description and rewards
tower.sweepUnavailable: This floor has not been cleared yet
modes.title: Modes
modes.expeditions.desc: Send idle heroes for gold and essence. 3 slots.
modes.rift.desc: Daily roguelite: 6 rooms, boons, elite and a boss. One run plus one for an ad.
modes.arena.desc: Async PvP: 3 ghost squads, 5 attacks a day, rating and tokens.
modes.locked.title: Modes locked
expeditions.title: Expeditions
expeditions.busy: Hero is already on an expedition
idle.title: Income
rift.title: Rift
rift.restText: The squad catches its breath by the fire. Continue.
arena.title: Arena
trials.title: Star Trial
modes.trials.desc: Fight a hero’s reflection at max level. Raises ★.
summon.title: Summon
summon.rates.title: Summon rates
summon.rates.body: 5★ — 1.2% (guaranteed by pull 70, rate rises from 45). 4★ — 10%. 3★ — the rest. A ten pull guarantees 4★+. The starter ten gives exactly one 5★; other pulls may be duplicates. Duplicates become shards. Crystals can be purchased, but odds do not depend on spending.
shop.title: Shop
shop.iapUnavailable: Payments are unavailable on this platform
shop.passDesc: 50 reward levels: crystals, seals, engravings and a 5★ of choice.
toast.battle: Battle arrives at step 4. Lobby only for now.
save.recovered: Save was corrupted — the previous version was restored.
battle.handHint: Charges carry between waves. Target: first living enemy.
battle.commandHint: Command: +35% damage to one target for 6s
battle.sacrificeHint: Sacrifice: 1.8× to all, 12% shield and +15 energy
battle.defeatAdvice: Tip: use Sacrifice against groups, upgrade the squad or change element.
squad.title: Squad
squad.hint.noTank: No vanguard: the front will break
squad.hint.elements: +{bonus}% ATK for {count} heroes of one element
heroes.title: Heroes
hero.engravingSoon: Engravings come from rewards and the shop
hero.engravings.emptyHint: Engravings come from quests, the shop and rewards. Equip a stone to strengthen the hero.
hero.engravings.mergeHint: 3 stones of one grade become 1 stone of the next grade.
hero.engravings.mergeNone: Not enough stones of this grade
hero.engravings.noSetBonus: Collect 2 stones of one set to gain a bonus.
hero.gear.emptyHint: Items drop on the 5th and 10th floors of every chapter.
hero.gear.noItemsForSlot: No items for this slot yet.
hero.gear.noSet: Collect 2 items of one set to gain a bonus.
hero.gear.enhanceHint: +5% to the main stat per level, up to +20.
set.engraving.guard.6: +20% HP; when an ally shatters, the squad gains a 30% shield
set.engraving.blade.6: +20% ATK; the first ultimate hits 30% harder
set.engraving.weep.6: when the hero shatters, the squad heals 25%
set.engraving.choir.6: an ally's ultimate gives everyone +10 energy
set.gear.echo-guard.4: below 30% HP — a 20% shield for 5 s (once per battle)
set.gear.choir.4: ultimate heals the squad for 5% HP
set.gear.glass.4: the first hit taken in battle is 50% weaker
tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.squad.title: Build your squad
tutorial.squad.body: Five heroes: tank in front, healer and casters behind. A recommended lineup is ready.
tutorial.battle.title: Your first battle
tutorial.battle.body: Tap “Battle”. The Master’s Hand gives three commands — use them if the fight turns.
tutorial.result.title: Battle result
tutorial.result.body: Gold, crystals and shards land here. The first clear of a floor pays more.
tutorial.upgrade.title: Upgrade a hero
tutorial.upgrade.body: Gold becomes levels. Raise your tank or your main damage dealer.
tutorial.summon.title: Free ten pull
tutorial.summon.body: On the “First Step” banner ten pulls are free and one hero is guaranteed 5★. The rest may repeat. Once per save.
settings.tutorial.desc: Three steps: squad, battle, result. You can replay it.
starter.title: First Step
starter.subtitle: Starter missions · 7 days
starter.freeTen.title: Free ten pull
starter.freeTen.body: 10 pulls on the “First Step” banner. Exactly one 5★; the rest may be duplicates. Once per save.
starter.mission.d1.title: First floor
starter.mission.d2.title: Third floor
starter.mission.d3.title: Ten summons
starter.mission.d4.title: Six heroes
starter.mission.d5.title: Three upgrades
starter.mission.d6.title: Thirty victories
starter.mission.d7.title: Tenth floor
next.title: What to do next
next.free-ten.title: Claim the free ten pull
next.free-ten.hint: “First Step” banner: 10 pulls and a guaranteed 5★.
next.starter.title: Starter missions
next.starter.hint: Rewards for the first 7 days are waiting.
next.reassemble.title: Reassemble fallen heroes
next.reassemble.hint: Their essence is preserved. Reassemble them in “Heroes”.
next.squad.title: Build your squad
next.squad.hint: Five slots: tank, blade, ranger, caster, healer.
next.roles.title: Roles are missing
next.roles.hint: Add a tank and a healer so the squad holds.
next.upgrade.title: Upgrade a hero
next.battle.title: Clear floor {n}
next.battle.hint: Start with the current floor — tower entry is free.
next.panel.winBody: Here is what will make you stronger right now.
next.panel.lossBody: Check your squad, elements and upgrades — then try again.
squad.hint.roles: Add a healer — the squad will live longer
squad.hint.tank: A tank holds the front: put one in the first two slots
squad.dragHint: Drag heroes or tap a slot
squad.presetHint: A preset stores squad heroes only. Unavailable heroes are skipped on load.
squad.presetInvalid: No available heroes in this preset
stat.crit.hint: Critical hit chance. A crit deals damage multiplied by CDMG.
stat.cdmg.hint: Critical damage multiplier. 150% means a crit deals 1.5× damage.
stat.er.hint: Energy efficiency: how fast the hero fills the ultimate.
stat.lifesteal.hint: Share of dealt damage returned to the hero as healing.
stat.dr.hint: Incoming damage reduction. 20% means the hero takes a fifth less.
stat.shield.hint: Shield strength: improves shields from skills and sets.
status.bleed.name: Bleed
status.bleed.hint: Damage over time; shields do not prevent the HP loss.
status.burn.name: Burn
status.burn.hint: Fire damage over time; duration stacks.
status.freeze.name: Freeze
status.freeze.hint: The target cannot act while the status lasts.
status.stun.name: Stun
status.stun.hint: The target skips turns; control caps apply.
status.slow.name: Slow
status.haste.name: Haste
status.taunt.name: Taunt
status.taunt.hint: Forces enemies to attack the status holder.
status.mark.name: Mark
status.mark.hint: Marked targets take stronger skill hits.
status.shield.name: Shield
status.shield.hint: Absorbs incoming damage until it expires or breaks.
status.regen.name: Regen
status.curse.name: Curse
status.curse.hint: Weakens the target: less damage and healing.
status.blessing.name: Blessing
offline.title: While you were away
offline.hint: Income grows with your highest floor. Collect it now or come back later.
hero.gear.presetHint: A preset stores the hero’s four slots. Items held by other heroes are skipped on load.
heroes.resonance.hint: Five slots raise heroes to the top-5 level: {n}.
heroes.resonance.pick: Choose a hero for the resonance slot
hero.artifact.noResources: Not enough shards, gold or essence
hero.reset.hint: Level, stars, skills and artifact return to base. Reset refunds 90% of invested resources; the squad stays unchanged.
modes.endgame.desc: World Echo, element towers, endless mode, hard mode and chapter challenges.
endgame.title: Endgame
endgame.world.desc: Weekly damage boss. 3 attempts per day; rewards for the week’s total damage.
endgame.towers.desc: 5 towers with 30 floors each. The squad needs at least 3 heroes of the tower element.
endgame.towerInvalid: At least 3 heroes of this element are required
endgame.endless.desc: Unlocks after floor 100. Best: {n}. Difficulty grows with every step.
endgame.hard.desc: Empowered chapter bosses with separate rewards. One clear per chapter.
endgame.hardLocked: Clear the chapter in the tower first
endgame.challenges.desc: Squad and time restrictions. Each challenge pays once.
endgame.challengeInvalid: The squad does not meet the restriction
live.title: Live
live.calendar.title: Login calendar
live.calendar.desc: One reward per day. Days 7, 14, 21 and 28 give larger rewards.
live.pass.title: Echo Pass
live.pass.desc: XP comes from dailies and floors. The free branch is open to everyone; the premium branch requires an active pass.
live.event.title: Glass Rain
event.battle.1.title: The first shard
event.battle.1.body: A glass drop falls from the sky. The squad heads to the impact.
event.battle.2.title: Glass forest
event.battle.2.body: Shards grow into trees. Someone whispers inside.
event.battle.3.title: The nameless girl
event.battle.3.body: One survivor among the shards. She does not remember her name.
event.battle.4.title: Keeper of the rain
event.battle.4.body: Glass rises into a wall and refuses to let the find go.
event.battle.5.title: Heart of glass
event.battle.5.body: The last battle for the right to take the girl out of the Tower.
mail.title: Mail
mail.welcome.subject: Welcome, Master
mail.welcome.body: The Tower has accepted you. Here is a small gift for the first step.
mail.event.subject: Glass Rain
mail.event.body: A glass rain falls over the Tower. Here is some glass for the exchange.
mail.return.3.subject: Back after 3 days
mail.return.3.body: The Tower missed you. Take a small gift for returning.
mail.return.7.subject: Back after 7 days
mail.return.7.body: A week without the Master. The Tower kept rewards for you.
mail.return.14.subject: Back after 14 days
mail.return.14.body: Two weeks of silence. The Tower waited and prepared a worthy reward.
achievements.title: Achievements
heroes.reassembleHint: {name} fell in battle. Reassemble from essence or obtain again.
heroes.reassembleKeeps: The hero returns at base ★, level 1, without skills or artifact.
battle.fallen: Fallen heroes: {n}. Their essence is preserved.
arena.noGhost: The ghost snapshot is no longer available
arena.newSeason: New season. Previous league: {league}. Rating softly reset.
social.title: Community
social.desc: Guild, friends and mercenaries — all local, no network.
social.guild.none: You are not in a guild
social.guild.noneHint: Join a guild to fight the shared weekly boss and earn contribution rewards.
social.guild.leaveConfirm: Leave the guild? This week's contribution is kept until the reset.
social.guild.bossDesc: The guild's shared boss. Every hit counts toward the total, and rewards depend on total damage.
social.friends.hint: One friend's hero can reinforce the squad. The mercenary never duplicates your heroes and fights as an extra unit.
throne.title: Master's Throne
throne.exchangeHint: Daily exchange limit. Rates are deliberately poor — a safety valve, not income.
throne.exchangeFail: Not enough resources or the limit is reached
battle.survived: Fallen heroes return to the squad
shop.passGift.title: Pass gift
shop.passGift.hint: Choose one 5★ hero. If you already own them, you get 30 star shards instead.
guide.greeting: I am Nim, keeper of the Echo. The Tower remembers everyone who enters — it will remember you too. Go on, I'll tell you what to do next.
guide.name: Nim
